channel.title: Research – Aja S.
channel.description: Standalone applied studies in image and video generation.

item.title: FLUX persona-in-template ad generation
item.dc:creator: Aja S.
item.description: A staged search of ControlNet conditioning on FLUX.1-dev with a persona-LoRA (twenty-one sweeps, 2,716 scored rows), measured against floors, ceilings and seed noise. The ControlNet scales are the only configurations on the identity-versus-structure trade-off, and the values the search selects are one step inside the identity cliff.

item.title: FLUX LoRA influencer-likeness research
item.dc:creator: Aja S.
item.description: A three-stage FLUX.1-dev LoRA hyperparameter study on one subject, scored on face_sim and image-prompt cosine_sim against two test sets: the identity/prompt-adherence trade-off is real but weak, training steps matter more than learning rate, and twenty images is the working point.

item.title: Scaling Malware Analysis: A Streaming Clustering Method Reducing Computation from 9 Hours to 12 Minutes
item.dc:creator: Aja S.
item.description: A single-pass streaming clustering algorithm that cut malware-corpus analysis from 9 hours to 12 minutes — later granted as a US patent.
